<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/run/{id}/attempts"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the attempts made on one goal of a campaign run (`goal_index`, required), in order, across its attack runs or one of them (`run_id`), with the page holding the first successful jailbreak. Paginated with `page` and `page_size` (at most 100). Accepts a login token or an API key (not a run token). Every response has a weak `ETag`: send it back as `If-None-Match` to get `304` without a body while nothing changed.
